paragraph: Glen Rock is essentially a single-family market, 63 sales over six months at a median of $1,250,000, and the numbers leave little room for interpretation. Homes are going for about 7.7 percent over list on average, 73 percent of them close above asking, and the median time on market is 11 days. That is a real seller's market, with many multiple offer situations. The typical sale is a four-bedroom colonial with two full baths, which is most of what this town is built from. Prices run from $800,000 to $2,685,000, so anchor on the median. Monthly medians climbed from $917,500 in February to the $1,275,000 to $1,350,000 range from May through July while closings kept rising, which is the normal early-summer peak holding steady. If Glen Rock follows the usual pattern, expect medians to drift some through fall with volume staying decent until deep winter. Come prepared to compete on the good ones.
